title: Server-Side Calculation & Result Display
user_story: As a user, I want submitting the form to compute the result server-side and re-render the page with a labeled result area, so that I can view the outcome without leaving the page.
acceptance_criteria: Submitting the form triggers server-side computation.
The page re-renders after submission displaying the entered inputs and selected operation.
A clearly labeled Result area shows the computed value.
The calculation correctly handles addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.
